notes: ROBOTS: https://www.pooky.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST, before any other request on the host - HTTP 200, 5,818 bytes, profile safari15_5. It opens '# we use Shopify as our ecommerce platform'. It names NO Claude agent anywhere: no ClaudeBot, no Claude-Web, no Claude-User, no Claude-SearchBot, no anthropic-ai - so no named-agent group exists and there is no hard stop. Seven groups are declared: 'User-agent: *' (the one that binds us), adsbot-google, Nutch ('Disallow: /'), AhrefsBot (Crawl-delay 10), AhrefsSiteAudit (Crawl-delay 10), MJ12bot (Crawl-delay 10), Pinterest (Crawl-delay 1) and Pinterestbot ('disallow: /'). The two blanket Disallow: / groups are Nutch and Pinterestbot - NEITHER is us, and a rule under another named bot does not apply, so nothing here blocks this crawl. The '*' group declares NO Crawl-delay, so only probe.py's own 2 s per-host gap applied and it was honoured. The '*' Disallow list is transactional and facet/crawl-trap paths: /admin, /cart, /carts, /account, /orders, /checkout(s), /policies/, /search, /services/login_with_shop, /.well-known/shopify/monorail, /recommendations/products, /cdn/wpm/*.js, /a/products/*, /a/returns/*, plus '/collections/*sort_by*', '/collections/*+*' (and %2B/%2b), '*/collections/*filter*&*filter*', '/*refinementList', '/*sortBy', '/*_pos', '/*pr_prod_strat*', '/?variant=*', '/*?*oseid=*' and the preview_theme_id/preview_script_id traps. COMPLIANCE: every URL touched is a bare /collections/<handle> path, a /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250&page=N call, a .atom feed, a sitemap file, or /?section_id=header. Not one Algolia facet URL was requested - no refinementList, no sortBy, no _pos, no filter parameter of any kind - and the site's internal /search was never used. ACCESS: plain direct probe.py curl_cffi fetches (safari15_5, safari17_0, safari18_0, safari18_0_ios, chrome120, chrome124, firefox133) - no proxy, no jina, no campaign parameter, no browser automation, zero 403s, no WAF challenge. TREE SOURCE - Pooky's storefront is a Shopify theme whose category grids and mega-menu are BOTH client-rendered (the raw /collections/<handle> HTML extracts to a 33-character text node: just the <title>), so no tree was ever guessed. Three server-side sources were used instead, all Pooky's own. (1) THE COMPLETE MEGA-MENU: Shopify's section-rendering endpoint https://www.pooky.com/?section_id=header returns the header section, whose <header> element carries data-main-menu-settings as a JSON object. Parsed in full: 6 top-level sections - Lighting, Rechargeables, Lampshades, Sockets & switches, By room, Accessories, plus the 'Last chance' link - and 100+ leaf links. I walked EVERY section: Lighting (All lighting: table/floor/wall/ceiling/rechargeable; Other popular links: chandeliers, pendant lights, outdoor lights, MIRRORS, pendant shades; wall fittings, picture lights, reading lights, bedside table lamps, sockets & switches; BATHROOM LIGHTS, IP-rated lights, lightbulbs), Rechargeables, Lampshades (shape/material/colour/size/style/collections - 40+ links), Sockets & switches (by finish/function/collection/ways), By room (bathroom, kitchen, outdoor, bedroom, hallway, living room, dining, office - all '<room> lights'), and Accessories (Bits and bobs: MIRRORS, lightbulbs, candle holders, candles; e-gift cards, ceiling fittings, flex, spare parts). (2) EACH PLP'S OWN CHILD TREE: every collection page ships a server-side window.childCollections array, which is Pooky's own parent-child map. /collections/bathroom returns exactly 7 children (bathroom-mirrors, bathroom-wall-lights, bathroom-flush-ceiling-lights, bathroom-ip-rated-lights, bathroom-pendant-lighting, bathroom-sconces, bathroom-ceiling-lights); /collections/mirrors returns 15, all attribute facets; /collections/bathroom-mirrors returns an EMPTY array, which is what proves it is a leaf and that rule 24 does not force a descent. (3) THE COLLECTIONS SITEMAP: https://www.pooky.com/sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml, 311 collection URLs, regex-swept for bath|shower|toilet|soap|basin|sink|tap|faucet|vanity|mirror|towel|wash|dispenser|toothbrush|sanitar|bidet|robe. Every hit was triaged; the sweep is what surfaced bathroom-lampshades, an orphan not present in either the mega-menu or any childCollections array. WHAT THE THREE SWEEPS AGREE ON: Pooky sells lighting, lampshades, sockets and switches, lightbulbs, candles, candle holders and MIRRORS. The only non-lighting product family is mirrors, and within it the only bathroom node is /collections/bathroom-mirrors - recorded. QTY SOURCE AND PROOF: because the grid is client-rendered by Algolia and its facet URLs are robots-disallowed, no rendered total exists to read and no Algolia call was made. The count is instead a FULL ENUMERATION TO EXHAUSTION via Shopify's own on-host product API for the collection, /collections/bathroom-mirrors/products.json?limit=250 - one page, 11 products, page 2 empty, so the enumeration is provably complete rather than a first-page artifact (the 250 limit is more than 20x the result). It was then CORROBORATED ON A SECOND INDEPENDENT SERVER-RENDERED SURFACE: Pooky's own Atom feed for the same collection, /collections/bathroom-mirrors.atom - advertised by the page itself via <link rel=alternate type=application/atom+xml> - contains exactly 11 <entry> elements, the same 11 products by title. Two independent Shopify surfaces agreeing at 11 is the evidence for the recorded figure; nothing was estimated and no parent number was reused. CONTENT CHECK ON THE RECORDED LEAF: all 11 products were enumerated and every one carries Shopify product_type 'Mirror' - Baloo mirror (whitewash / ebony / gold), Smaller and Regular Feathers mirror in antiqued gold, Round and Rectangular bevelled Luxor mirror, Flynn mirror (teal / green), Zelda mirror in green glass with gold, Frill mirror in pink and red. Not one is a light fitting. Rule 11 is decisive here: primary product type is mirror, not lighting, so this goes to BATHROOM, and rule 10 forbids letting the word 'Bathroom' exclude it. The collection's own description confirms the intent - 'Upgrade your bathroom with our range of bathroom mirrors... We love placing our IP-rated wall lights on either side'. DISCRIMINATION: counts differ node by node across the 15 collections measured (0, 7, 10, 11, 11, 19, 19, 20, 21, 27, 42, 47, 50, 63, 143) - not a site-wide constant - and each collection's own collectionObject JSON title matched the node requested ('Bathroom mirrors', 'Bathroom lights', 'Mirrors'), as did each canonical link. WHAT WAS EXCLUDED AND WHY: the six bathroom LIGHTING children and the IP-rated node to Lighting under rules 11/19 (never duplicated into Bathroom); bathroom-lampshades as a genuinely empty node; /collections/mirrors and its 15 attribute children to Decor under rules 2/21 after inspection; candles and candle holders to Decor under rule 21; /collections/sale and the 'Last chance' menu link as promotional (rule 25, never recorded). DEDUP: dedup.already_extracted() was run on every candidate leaf and every review URL. ZERO hits - the 12,194-URL exclusion index contains NO pooky.com entry of any kind, so Pooky appears in neither Furniture.xlsx nor Final.xlsx and nothing here was suppressed by a prior pass. NOT FOUND ON THIS SITE - a genuine, checked absence, not an assumption: Pooky is a decorative lighting manufacturer. Across the full mega-menu, the 311-collection sitemap and every childCollections array, there is no sanitaryware, no basins, sinks, toilets or bidets, no baths or bathtubs, no showers, shower systems or shower accessories, no enclosures, screens or doors, no taps, mixers or faucets, no bathroom furniture, vanity units or bathroom cabinets, no bathroom storage, no towel rails, rings or hooks, no toilet-roll holders, soap dispensers or toothbrush holders, no towels, bath mats, shower curtains or robes. The expected outcome for this company was NO BATHROOM FOUND; it is not, solely because rule 11 puts Pooky's genuine 11-product Bathroom mirrors collection in Bathroom rather than Lighting. RESULT: 1 grouping row + 1 leaf row (11), 12 review entries.
